name: Advent
overview: Advent centers on the promised coming of Jesus Christ, the Messiah foretold by the prophets. Isaiah prophesied a virgin birth and the naming of the child Immanuel, signifying God with us, while also describing His divine titles such as Wonderful Counselor and Prince of Peace. Micah pinpointed Bethlehem as the birthplace of this eternal ruler, and Matthew records the miraculous conception by the Holy Spirit. John affirms that the Word became flesh, dwelling among us in grace and truth, fulfilling these ancient promises.
